title: Add New Tasks
user_story: As a user, I want to type task text into an input field and submit it with a button, so that I can quickly capture items I need to do.
acceptance_criteria: The page displays a text input field and an 'Add Task' button.
Entering text and clicking the button adds the task to the visible list immediately without reloading the page.
Submitting an empty or whitespace-only input does not add a new task and shows a brief validation message.
After successful submission, the input field clears automatically for the next entry.
